aroundJeff.title: 100 Years of Nebraskaland Magazine — Durham Museum Exhibit Opens June 20
aroundJeff.excerpt: The Durham Museum in Omaha opens 100 Years of Nebraskaland Magazine on Saturday, June 20, 2026. The exhibit traces a century of Nebraska outdoor storytelling, from Outdoor Nebraska's first issue in 1926 through Nebraskaland today. Jeff Kurrus has served as editor since 2013.

aroundJeff.title: Winner — 2026 Nebraska Book Award, Children's Award
aroundJeff.excerpt: The Legend of Donnie Bats: Greatness Lives in Every Kid won the Children's Award in the 2026 Nebraska Book Awards. The Nebraska Center for the Book and the Nebraska Library Commission announced the winners on August 31. Winners are honored at the Nebraska Celebration of Books on Saturday, November 14, at the UNL City Campus Union in Lincoln.
